mapper.update: UPDATE oms_order SET delivery_sn = #{deliverySn}, delivery_company = #{deliveryCompany}, delivery_time = NOW(), status = 2, modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 1 AND delete_status = 0
UPDATE oms_order SET status = 4, modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 0 AND delete_status = 0
UPDATE sms_coupon_history SET use_status = 0, use_time = NULL, order_id = NULL, order_sn = NULL WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND use_status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, oi.id item_id, oi.product_id item_product_id, oi.product_sn item_product_sn, oi.product_pic item_product_pic, oi.product_name item_product_name, oi.product_brand item_product_brand, oi.product_price item_product_price, oi.product_quantity item_product_quantity, oi.product_attr item_product_attr, oh.id history_id, oh.operate_man history_operate_man, oh.create_time history_create_time, oh.order_status history_order_status, oh.note history_note FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN oms_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN oms_order_operate_history oh ON o.id = oh.order_id WHERE o.id = #{id} ORDER BY oi.id ASC,oh.create_time DESC
